risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and explains a severe deterioration in 2024 results, including a 19.1% sales decline, net loss, major impairment and restructuring charges, divestiture losses, and sharply higher interest expense. Risk exposure is elevated from weak agricultural demand, cyclicality, currency volatility, increased leverage, litigation contingencies, and seasonal dealer inventory dynamics, although the text remains generally transparent rather than evasive.
